original_atom.biological_role: Dietary route to PLP, the active cofactor for aromatic L-amino-acid decarboxylase. This is not an independent dopamine-synthesis cofactor

original_overlay.permitted_wording: Vitamin B6 is a Derived Dietary Requirement because dietary B6 vitamers are converted to PLP, the Direct cofactor requirement for aromatic L-amino-acid decarboxylase. original_atom.evidence_limitation: Salvage of food vitamin B6 to pyridoxal 5'-phosphate does not show that higher vitamin B6 intake increases cystathionine beta-synthase or cystathionine gamma-lyase flux. Moderate B6 restriction changed cystathionine handling but did not significantly reduce total transsulfuration in the assessed human tracer study.
